gamma.platform: Ubuntu 22.04 amd64 LP64, GCC 11.4, libc6-dev headers

assumptions: One batch with two boxes; three units per box.
semantics.initial_state: static C initialization; main is the sole entry
semantics.library_model: pthread and C library built into the pinned Deagle binary
semantics.preprocessor: GCC system preprocessor as invoked by the locked Deagle C front end
semantics.thread_bound: fixed by the protected harness: one create per worker, no spawn loop

property.description: Two boxes of three units must contribute six units after the worker joins.
property.fingerprint_algorithm: sha256 of stripped UTF-8 assertion statement, excluding newline
